text.p: These are the leading stories in Skopje press on Monday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia's internal debt amounts to some 10 billion German marks.

- Macedonia received $300 million or one third of the money needed for construction of the railway to Bulgaria. Another $150 million missing to complete the entire project. The government expects the rest of the money to get from several European Union countries.
- A car bomb exploded in Kumanovo on Sunday injuring Romeo Zivic, a known criminal. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201 196
